content.title: Edit one results-header search parameter family on a dated Homes query
content.intent: Prove that a guest can change any one source-named parameter family already present in the Homes results header and refresh the results in place without returning to the homepage.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: state_flow because the promise is an in-place results-page edit followed by refreshed results without homepage navigation; eqp because destination, dates, and guests are the three source-named editable parameter families with the same expected outcome. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies; covering array degraded to straight enumeration per tool note "strength=1 (degraded from 2: only 1 input(s))" for the single varying input edit_target. No budget ceiling supplied; this scenario was kept.
